title: Attachments

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

name.description: Display name, as in items.json (the game's UI table). Absent when the game has none.

type.description: Attachment type, for example `Magazine`, `Muzzle`, `Sight` (the game's `Item.Attachment.*` tag).

contexts.description: Item context tags, which weapon slots match against.

attribute.description: Attribute, for example `Weapon.AimTime` (the game's `Attribute.Gameplay.*` tag without the prefix).

op.description: How the value combines: `multiplyCompound` and `multiply` scale the attribute (1.1 is +10%), `add` adds, `override` replaces. Several `multiplyCompound` modifiers multiply together.

value.description: The number applied. For `multiply` and `multiplyCompound`, 1.1 means +10%.

items.description: One change an attachment makes to a gameplay attribute.

modifiers.description: Changes applied to the weapon while the attachment is fitted.

attribute.description: Attribute, for example `Weapon.AimTime` (the game's `Attribute.Gameplay.*` tag without the prefix).

op.description: How the value combines: `multiplyCompound` and `multiply` scale the attribute (1.1 is +10%), `add` adds, `override` replaces. Several `multiplyCompound` modifiers multiply together.

value.description: The number applied. For `multiply` and `multiplyCompound`, 1.1 means +10%.

items.description: One change an attachment makes to a gameplay attribute.

characterModifiers.description: Changes applied to the character carrying the weapon, such as sway.

magazine.description: Magazines: how many rounds fit, and which calibers.

calibers.description: Calibers the magazine takes (the game's `Item.Caliber.*` tags without the prefix).

attachments.description: One entry per attachment item, sorted by item id.

description: Weapon attachments: the attribute changes each one makes, and capacity and calibers for magazines. Ids are item ids from items.json.
